*Turn a customer’s intent into a live, multi\-cloud network — automatically, anywhere in the world — and learn the entire stack while you do it.*
 THE MISSION
   

  

 When a company connects its data centers, clouds, and offices on Alkira, our team is what makes it happen. The customer tells us what they want — connect these networks, across these clouds, with these policies — and we turn that into a real, working network in minutes instead of weeks, automatically.
   

  

 We’re the Playbooks / Orchestration team, and we build that automation. Using a mix of Ansible, Python, and Go, we set up the networking stack on our Cloud Exchange Points (CXPs) and run the workflows that keep it healthy — including tricky operations like safely restarting a node. We bring up new virtual network functions (VNFs), build the tooling and CLI used to inspect and configure each node, and work closely with the Routing, Data Path, and Backend teams. Our team spans the US and India, and above all we make sure every customer network comes up correctly and reliably, across every cloud.
   

  

 LOCATION: This is a hybrid work environment that requires onsite at San Jose office on Tuesdays and Thursdays
   

  

**What You’ll Work On**
* Automate the cloud. Write the Ansible playbooks that provision infrastructure and stand up network services across AWS, Azure, and GCP — VPCs/VNets, subnets, tunnels, NAT, routing, and security policy.
* Build the engines. Develop the Go task engines that push this configuration onto the CXP nodes at scale — running provisioning and teardown against live state, and rebuilding a node’s entire configuration after a controlled restart.
* Bring up new capabilities. Integrate new VNFs as we light up new services and capabilities.
* Own the tooling. Build the Python tooling and CLI engineers use to inspect, configure, and debug the networking stack on the nodes.
* Model the work. Extend the configuration and task models that translate a single provisioning request into the exact commands applied on the nodes.
* Keep it fast and correct. Help connectivity stay correct, fast, and reliable across clouds and at scale.
* Solve real problems. Chase tricky production provisioning issues to their root cause and drive the fix — and collaborate with Routing, Data Path, and Backend on how configuration flows end to end.


*You won’t touch all of this on day one. Most engineers start in one layer and grow outward fast.*
**Who You Are**
 We’re looking for a well\-rounded Software Engineer with a basic grounding in networking technologies. Our stack spans several layers — Ansible playbooks, Go task engines, Python tooling, the networking stack on the nodes — and sits right next to the C\-based data path. You don’t need to be an expert in all of it. Bring strong fundamentals and real curiosity about how networks and clouds work, and you’ll start in one layer and grow into the rest.
   

  

**You'll Thrive Here If You Have**
* Strong software fundamentals — data structures, problem\-solving, clean code, and the patience to debug. Hands\-on coding in at least one of C, Python, or Go, and the appetite to pick up the others — we use all three everyday, and the engineers who range across them go furthest.
* Comfort on Linux — the shell, processes, logs, and the everyday networking tools.
* Hands\-on familiarity with core networking — TCP/IP, and the curiosity to go deeper.
* A working mental model of the cloud — at least one of AWS, Azure, or GCP: what a VPC/VNet, subnet, and security group actually are.
* A debugging mindset — you genuinely enjoy chasing a problem until you find the real cause.


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Ansible or other configuration\-automation experience.
* You use AI\-assisted development tools like Claude Code — we lean on them to build workflows, write debug tooling, and move faster across the entire software development lifecycle.
* Experience building CLIs, task runners, or automation that runs at scale.
* Familiarity with firewalls, load balancers, and similar network services.


 WHY YOU’LL GROW FAST HERE
   

  

 The orchestration layer touches every part of the system — clouds, Linux, the networking stack, and the data path next door. That makes it one of the best vantage points in the company for an early\-career engineer: you’ll get unusually broad exposure, work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with networking and systems experts, and build a deep, end\-to\-end picture of how a real cloud network works. Strong all\-rounders here don’t stay in one lane — they move fluidly between layers and become the people who understand how the whole thing fits together.
   

  

 ON\-CALL
   

  

 On\-call is a mandatory part of this role. You’ll join the orchestration on\-call rotation and help debug and resolve
   

  

 production provisioning issues, with coverage coordinated across the US and India. It’s also where a lot of the
   

  

 deepest learning happens — there’s no faster way to understand a system than to keep it running.
